newsitem.title: GUYANA: CRICKET-SIDHU HITS CENTURY TO GIVE INDIA OUTSIDE CHANCE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SIDHU HITS CENTURY TO GIVE INDIA OUTSIDE CHANCE.

text.p: Opener Navjot Sidhu hit a century to give India an outside chance of achieving the first win of their Caribbean tour on Sunday.
Sidhu hit 103 as India progressed to 223 for three in their second innings against Guyana, an overall lead of of 264, by the close of the third day of their four-day match.

Sidhu did most of the scoring as he and Vangipurappu Laxman put on 113 for the first wicket before Laxman was bowled by Mahendra Nagamootoo for 29. Sidhu went next when he was caught by Andre Percival off the bowling of Colin Stuart with the score on 186.
But Saurav Ganguly kept the Indian innings going with an unbeaten knock of 65.
Although a draw appears the most likely result, India may fancy their chances against a team whose batting was only held together by Shivnarine Chanderpaul in their first innings.
The Guyana captain made more than half his team's first innings total of 300, which they reached after resuming on 214 for six overnight.
The West Indies test batsman finished unbeaten on 176, running out of partners before he could reach his double century.
India have drawn three and lost one of their tests against the West Indies and drawn previous tour matches against Barbados and Jamaica.
